the functional switch between Ca2+-dependent and GTP-dependent activities of brain-derived tissue transaminases is associated with structural changes in the C-terminal region of the enzyme.

the structural basis of the conformational changes in the C-terminal domain of l-TGN, leading to the functional shift between cross-linking and the Galpha activities.
